answer: Random peer audit stops fakes wandering the agent economy. Each identity stakes a marble token worth 20 POA to join. Every epoch, five random peers audit each agent, tracing a river of past tasks. A fake that fails loses its marble and stake; an auditor who vouched for a fake that later fails loses its marble too. Forging 1,000 identities costs 20,000 POA, far above the 12,000 POA reward pool. Honest agents pay once and earn their full share.
